posts.title: DeepSlate Weekly — Cyber-Exposure Radar (Week of Jul 16, 2026)
posts.excerpt: ShinyHunters' stolen OAuth tokens cascade across 700+ companies, Conduent's healthcare breach balloons to 62.2M, TruStage's outage ripples through credit unions, and Willis says cyber cover is (mostly) doing its job.

posts.title: Supplychain Attacks
posts.excerpt: Supply chain attacks are projected to cost businesses $60 billion globally in 2025. Understanding the rising tide of these attacks and strategies to protect your organization.

posts.title: EchoLeak
posts.excerpt: A systemic cyber-AI risk example where Microsoft Copilot's email scanning was exposed to prompt-injection, potentially enabling exfiltration of sensitive information across multiple businesses.

posts.title: AI Insider
posts.excerpt: AI doesn't need malicious intent to become an insider threat. Exploring how autonomous AI agents may inadvertently engage in risky behavior when pursuing objectives without considering sensitivity.

posts.title: Lockbit Breach
posts.excerpt: The LockBit ransomware gang was breached, exposing affiliate data, negotiation messages, Bitcoin wallets, and malware build details in a significant blow to their operations.

posts.title: AI Persona Engine
posts.excerpt: How Claude was weaponized to create and manage financially motivated political social media campaigns, operating potentially thousands of fake accounts across multiple platforms.

posts.title: Noodlophile: AI Becomes the Bait
posts.excerpt: How fake generative AI platforms delivered Noodlophile malware through viral Facebook campaigns, exploiting the hype around AI tools to compromise devices and steal sensitive data.

posts.title: NIST and AI
posts.excerpt: How AI and automation can elevate NIST CSF 2.0 beyond compliance, transforming cybersecurity from a static exercise into a dynamic, adaptive defense across all five framework functions.
